entities.name: Fadhéla Dziria
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fadhéla Dziria, officially Fadhéla Madani Bent el-Mahdi was an Algerian singer in the Hawzi style of Andalusian classical music. Her first name is also seen as Fadila, Fadhila, or Fadela, and her chosen last name as Dziriya. Dziria means Algerian—so she was, professionally, "Fadhéla the Algerian".

entities.summary: Fadhéla Dziria, officially Fadhéla Madani Bent el-Mahdi was an Algerian singer in the Hawzi style of Andalusian classical music. Her first name is also seen as Fadila, Fadhila, or Fadela, and her chosen last name as Dziriya. Dziria means Algerian—so she was, professionally, "Fadhéla the Algerian".
